zoom.description: Page zoom applied to new browser tabs.

pullRequestLinks.openInAppAriaLabel: Open pull requests in T3 Code

devices.updateFailedTitle: Device settings not saved on all environments

agentBrowserAccess.defaultScopeDescription: Allow agents to use the shared browser. Projects can override it.

profiles.notConnected: You're not connected to a server yet.
